scenario_geometry.direction_evidence: Plane::update_loiter() (navigation.cpp:362-372) sets loiter.direction = -1 only when aparm.loiter_radius < 0 or the WP carries loiter_ccw; WP_LOITER_RAD is live-read POSITIVE and LOITER mode sets no ccw flag, so direction = +1 = clockwise. A clockwise orbit means increasing compass heading and a sustained RIGHT (positive) bank.
